inj.note: Nelson is set for knee surgery due to an issue the veteran offensive guard has been having with cartilage fragments. reporters said Friday that the plan is for Nelson to avoid IR and return to the Seahawks after the team's Week 11 bye. Grey Zabel is set to start at left guard for Sunday's game.

news.h: Seahawks' Quenton Nelson, Sam Darnold among starters ruled out
news.d: New Seahawks trade acquisition Quenton Nelson will have a "minor procedure" and is one of six starters, including QB Sam Darnold, who won't play vs. the Cardinals.

news.h: Sam Darnold is struggling under pressure, but Seahawks patient with O-line
news.d: Seattle's trade for Quenton Nelson last week shuffled the offensive line ahead of its decisive loss to the Bears. Will the pass protection get better?

news.h: Quenton Nelson: Cherished time with Colts but excited to play for Seahawks
news.d: Eight-time Pro Bowl guard Quenton Nelson expressed excitement over what he called "a new opportunity" with the Seahawks following eight-plus seasons with the Colts.

news.h: Why did Seahawks trade for Quenton Nelson? Are the Colts just getting started?
news.d: The Seahawks acquired an All-Pro guard two weeks before the deadline. What does this mean for them and the Colts?

news.h: McAfee thanks Quenton Nelson for service to Colts after being traded to Seahawks
news.d: McAfee thanks Quenton Nelson for service to Colts after being traded to Seahawks
